newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Verbund shares off after 9-mth results.
newsitem.headline: Verbund shares off after 9-mth results.

text.p: Shares in Austria's national grid company Oesterreichische Elektrizitaetswirtschaft AG (Verbund) fell on the Vienna bourse after the company said it would have to work hard to match 1995 profit levels this year.
At 0755 GMT Verbund was down 2.0 schillings at 742.
"The (nine-month) results were neutral...but it's not likely to attract new investors," a trader said.
He said the share was technically in a consolidation phase but was likely to hold around the 740 level.
Verbund reported a 7.4 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 872.7 million schillings in the first nine months but cautioned that it would have to work hard to achieve a full-year profit matching 1995.
